title: Concord project tooling declaration
description: Shape of .concord/tooling.v1.json, the per-project record of which quality tools, scanners, and check commands are already set up. Intent fields (purpose, invocation, tier, notes) are hand-authored; resolution claims (config_path exists, ci_reference appears in a workflow) are proved by scripts/check-project-tooling.py, because JSON Schema cannot express them.

id.description: Stable kebab-case identifier, unique within the manifest.

purpose.description: What the tool checks or does, as one bounded sentence.

invocation.description: The command an agent runs. A fact about the tool, not guidance about when to run it.

tier.description: Cost class. fast runs in seconds, standard in minutes, slow beyond that.

config_path.description: Repository-relative path of the tool's configuration or entry script. Proved to resolve by the checker; omit when the tool needs no repository config.

in_ci.description: Whether a required workflow already runs the tool. Separates checks that already ran from checks an agent must invoke itself.

ci_reference.description: Literal substring that must appear in a file under .github/workflows/. Required when in_ci is true, forbidden when false.

notes.description: Non-obvious constraints an agent needs before running the tool. Facts only.
